name: Rob Wagner

bio.statement: His official page presents Wagner as Senate President and Senator for District 19.
bio.excerpt: I am proud to have the honor of serving as Senate President and to serve as the Senator for District 19

bio.statement: In his voters' pamphlet statement, Wagner lists his occupation as Oregon Senate President, with a background as an associate vice president at Portland Community College.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Oregon Senate President Occupational Background: Portland Community College (Associate Vice President)

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 41

bio.statement: Wagner lists an MA from George Washington University and a BA from Portland State University.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: George Washington University (MA), Portland State University (BA), Lake Oswego HS

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 41

bio.statement: Wagner lists state senator and Lake Oswego School Board as his prior governmental experience.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: State Senator, Lake Oswego School Board

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 41

positions.statement: In a January 2026 Portland Tribune interview, Wagner said the state budget shortfall means cuts will need to happen.
positions.excerpt: Cuts are going to need to happen,

positions.statement: In the same interview, Wagner said transportation funding needs a bipartisan conversation about long-term solutions.
positions.excerpt: What we need is a bipartisan conversation on long-term funding solutions.

positions.statement: Wagner lists education, jobs and workforce training, environment and parks, health care, public safety, housing and quality of life as his priorities.
positions.excerpt: I prioritize things that are most important to our community and state: education, jobs and workforce training, environment and parks, health care, public safety, housing, and quality of life.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 41

positions.statement: Wagner says Oregon must protect clean air, land and water, build resilience to wildfires and heat waves, and defend natural places.
positions.excerpt: we must protect our clean air, land, and water; build resilience amidst wildfires and heat waves; and defend our natural places

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 41

positions.statement: Wagner says he will protect health care for seniors, low-income families and children and ensure Planned Parenthood provides preventive and reproductive care.
positions.excerpt: we must protect health care for Oregonians, including seniors, low-income families, and children; and ensure that Planned Parenthood provides preventive and reproductive health care

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 41

positions.statement: Wagner says Oregon must invest in education, infrastructure, public safety, jobs and economic development.
positions.excerpt: We must invest in Oregon: education, infrastructure, public safety, jobs, and economic development

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Clackamas County edition), p. 41
